title: RatingIndicator
description: Fiori rating indicator: stars with half values, sizes S/M/L, read-only/display-only, UI5 keyboard model (ui5-rating-indicator).

usage.summary: Collect an icon-based rating or display an aggregate rating.
useWhen: Let users evaluate an item with a row of rating icons.
Show an average or overall rating without editing it using displayOnly.
Name the rating subject clearly so users understand what they are evaluating.

avoidWhen.when: Adjust a numeric setting along a continuous or stepped range.
